chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Ibn Abi Ya'fur, from al-Mu'alla ibn Khunays, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah (عليه السلام) about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
Surely Allah commands you to render the trusts to their rightful owners.
He (عليه السلام) said: Allah commanded the first Imam to hand over to the Imam after him everything that was with him.

key_terms.الَّذِي بَعْدَهُ: the Imam who comes after him as successor
key_terms.الْأَمَانَاتِ: the trusts entrusted by Allah, understood here as what the Imam must pass on
key_terms.الْإِمَامَ: the Imam, the divinely appointed leader
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ الْأَوَّلَ: the first Imam in relation to the one succeeding him
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the statement or verse of Allah

ai.seo_question: How do the Imams (عليهم السلام) interpret the verse, 'Surely Allah commands you to render trusts to their owners'?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the verse about rendering trusts as applying to the transmission of the Imamate and all that belongs to it from one Imam to the next. It presents the divine trust here as the sacred authority, knowledge, and entrusted possessions that each Imam must deliver to his successor.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, from Ibn Abu Yafour, from Al Moalla Bin Khunays who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[4:58] Surely Allah Commands you to make over trusts to their owners.

Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded the former Imam<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>asws</sup> should hand over to the Imam<sup>asws</sup> who is to be from after him<sup>asws</sup>, everything which is with him<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar from ibn abu Ya‘fur from Mu‘alla ibn al-Khunays who has said that
I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High.
“Allah (God) commands you to return that which had been entrusted to you to the rightful owners.. .” [4:58]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “it is the command of Allah that the preceding Imam (a.s.) transfer to the succeeding Imam (a.s.) every thing that is with him.”
